description: This file contains selector functions for plugin-related UI components and state in a Mattermost web application, including plugin settings, menu items, header components, and licensing-based feature toggles.

methods.name: getPluginUserSettings
methods.description: Selector to retrieve plugin user settings from the global state.

methods.name: getFilesDropdownPluginMenuItems
methods.description: Selector to retrieve FilesDropdown plugin menu items.

methods.name: getUserGuideDropdownPluginMenuItems
methods.description: Selector to retrieve UserGuideDropdown plugin menu items.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderPluginComponents
methods.description: Selector to retrieve channel header plugin components, filtering out those overridden by app bar components.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderMenuPluginComponentsShouldRender
methods.description: Selector to determine which channel header menu components should render based on their shouldRender functions.

methods.name: getChannelHeaderMenuPluginComponents
methods.description: Selector to retrieve channel header menu components that should render, using shallow comparison.

methods.name: getChannelMobileHeaderPluginButtons
methods.description: Selector to retrieve mobile header plugin buttons.

methods.name: getChannelIntroPluginButtons
methods.description: Selector to retrieve channel intro plugin buttons.

methods.name: getAppBarPluginComponents
methods.description: Selector to retrieve app bar plugin components.

methods.name: getSidebarBrowseOrAddChannelMenuPluginComponents
methods.description: Selector to retrieve sidebar browse/add channel menu plugin components.

methods.name: getMainMenuPluginComponents
methods.description: Selector to retrieve main menu plugin components.

methods.name: shouldShowAppBar
methods.description: Selector to determine if the app bar should be shown based on enabled state and component presence.

methods.name: showNewChannelWithBoardPulsatingDot
methods.description: Function to check if the pulsating dot for new channel with board tour should be shown.

methods.name: getSearchPluginSuggestions
methods.description: Selector to retrieve search plugin suggestions if licensed.

methods.name: getSearchBoxHints
methods.description: Selector to retrieve search box hints if licensed.

methods.name: getSearchButtons
methods.description: Selector to retrieve search buttons if licensed.

methods.name: getPluginDisplayName
methods.description: Function to get a plugin's display name by its ID, with fallbacks.
